Public German handwriting fixtures

Source: FH Suedwestfalen, fhswf/german_handwriting dataset on Hugging Face.
Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/fhswf/german_handwriting
Revision: f08067881aafb8ad50f0ca14c1e57314438b79a2
License declared by the dataset publisher: Academic Free License 3.0 (AFL-3.0).
License text: https://opensource.org/license/afl-3.0
Files fixture-0.jpg, fixture-1.jpg, fixture-2.jpg are unmodified image downloads
from default/train rows 0, 1 and 2 of the public dataset viewer.
The images are verified against their SHA256 hashes recorded before the reset.
Exact hashes, transcripts and stable row URLs are recorded in fixtures.json.
The source dataset README is preserved in dataset-README.md.

These short images contain no user-provided documents. This dataset was a
training source for the model, so prior inference results are integration
evidence only, not an independent accuracy benchmark on unseen writers.

Model: naeyn/de-htr-web-v2
Revision: 6241c1ff0fd42725e0dc46fcd3217469cac851bb
Weights Apache-2.0 for rights held by the publisher. Original license and
NOTICE-training-data.md are preserved. The notice attributes ScaDS.AI German
handwriting (CC BY 4.0) and FH Suedwestfalen handwriting (AFL-3.0).

The raw model previously emitted a dash on an empty white 128x64 line.
Application integration needs blank-content rejection and human review.
